reviews.text: Excellent service ❤️ The best animal clinic 🥰 …

I want to thank the amazing team at this veterinary clinic for the excellent care they provide my dog. From day one, they have treated us with so much love, patience, and professionalism. They always take the time to explain everything in detail and make both pets and their owners feel calm and well cared for. It's clear they truly love animals and care about their well-being. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. Thank you for all the love and dedication you put into your work! Thanks to the vet and Yadan, they always make me feel so safe during my baby's appointments.

It's truly a shame that places like this exist. Here, it seems the only thing that matters is money, regardless of the worry and desperation of those who arrive with their sick pets.

In my experience, they took advantage of the situation to charge as much as possible without offering a clear diagnosis or a treatment that inspired confidence. I felt their main interest was making money, not providing the attention and care our pets deserve.

If I could give zero stars, I would without hesitation. If you truly love your pet and are looking for professional, honest, and dedicated care, I would not recommend this place.
I have been bringing my pets to this clinic for over seven years, and I truly appreciate how kind and caring they are, treating my pets as if they were their own.
We traveled from Oakland Park to Hialia just because it's the best place to take our furry friend. Excellent service.

One star is absolutely terrible service. In the end, they couldn't figure out what was wrong with my puppy. I don't recommend this place. The consultation cost $35 more just for a small neck scraping; they didn't even give an accurate diagnosis. 0/0

This place is my life savior, There’s no other clinic that will treat your dog with such love like this one. What I like about them is that they’re completely honest! they have saved my dogs life twice already this time he was literally on his deathbed and they brought him back to life. The doctor and the team are so amazing and loving, thank you so much Yadan for going the extra mile with my furbaby I truly appreciate all the long nights. They would even send me pictures to see how he was doing throughout the day meanwhile I was working! Thank you guys!!

Great animal clinic. The best one I've ever been to.

They truly treat your pet like one of their own. They are very friendly, caring, and helpful.

They really explain the problem and help find a solution.

They are very concerned about your pet and give you the best service.

The staff is also very great and friendly; they almost feel like family!

Do not bring your pet here if you value their safety. The level of irresponsibility and disregard for both animal welfare and basic regulations is deeply concerning. A place entrusted with the care of animals should operate with far more professionalism than what is demonstrated here.

I took my cat Zuko for her shots and annual visit. First time being here. From the moment I called them to make the appointment they gave me a very nice and patient vibe. The clinic is very nice inside and looks well taken care of, oh and they have a very cute and funny parrot as part of their staff🦜.  Overall  the experience was great, and I was out of there pretty fast with my cat. And not to mention they were very nice to my cat during the clinical part, my cat seemed calm around them despite obviously being a little scared of being at a vet clinic. I will definitely come back for my annual visits with Zuko and I would recommend it, if you’re looking for a vet. Prices were also very reasonable in my opinion. 10/10 💕

We have been coming to this vet for years and trust them completely. They cared for our dog Ginger (RIP) and now our two cats. The Doctors and the team are super  knowledgeable, caring, realistic, and always honest. It truly feels like a family environment. If you love your pets take them to E&L

Thank you Karen, thank you doctor, and thank you to the whole team. There are no words to express my gratitude for everything you do for my 85-year-old aunt and her pet, Pitico. I am so grateful to this team—the only one of a kind in this city!
Excellent attention

This is the best animal clinic I've ever been to. My dog, Leah Gutierrez, was the oldest there, and they cared for her until we had to put her to sleep. It's a comfortable, hygienic place, and above all, the professionals are very fair.
The most caring and detailed vets and vet technician you could ask for!

I can't say enough good things about E & L Animal Clinic. They always take excellent care of my dog, not only with his health but also by handling all the paperwork for international travel. The process is always smooth and stress-free thanks to their professionalism and attention to detail. I feel confident knowing my pet is in the best hands. Highly recommend!

I don't have enough words to thank E & L Animal Clinic. They always take excellent care of my dog, not only regarding his health but also by handling all the paperwork for traveling abroad. Thanks to their professionalism and attention, the process is always simple and stress-free. I feel at ease knowing my pet is in the best hands. Highly recommended!

Excellent staff, they helped me with my kitten
I’m planning a consultation soon
Thanks
The staff is very friendly and they take excellent care of my dogs. It is the best veterinary clinic I have ever been to.
Great care! Dedicated and professional

I'm writing from the bottom of my heart to thank the doctor for her work.
My Lola just had surgery, and I'm speechless at how wonderful this team was.
These people are truly exceptional in their work and the dedication they bring to it.
Thank you, Dr. Idalia, Massiel, Yadan, Dani, Karen… and almost everyone else!
May God bless you and grant you all the prosperity you deserve!
Thank you!

The first time I took my sick puppy here, i came as a walk in and it took about 30-40mns to finally get seen by doctor. She seemed not thourough like she didnt want to check everything basic like the dogs ears. She did recommend the proper meds that worked for a little while but his condition was congenital and there was nothing else vets can do. I had to put my poor puppy to sleep and these people put so much stress on him that i will never forget the screams he yelled his last day on Earth. I wish they would have handled him better and more compassionately.
Best place for my pets. They treat them with so much love and care. The doctors and staff are amazing.
My dog simba loves the doctors and staff. He loves coming to the clinic
I have been taking my pets here for over 10 years. There’s no better place and care for my furry babies. Both doctors are so amazing and loving. Highly recommended
Best place to take your pets. Both doctors are amazing and loving . The staff is welcoming and great!

The Botox lady is super rude and entitled. I would never, ever bring my pets to a place with so low quality people, if they can mistreat and be disrespectful towards people what can possibly be expected when it comes to your pets?
They were quick to ensure care. Super knowledgeable and sweetie with our fur baby Minnie. Gracias a todos por su atencion.

they saved my kittys life, we came there in a panic and the doctor went above and beyond, she helped us so much. i even cried in their office and they were very supportive and kind. i highly recommend this clinic!
Excellent place

I've been taking my dog here since he was a puppy, and I couldn't ask for better care. Dr. Rodriguez has always gone above and beyond, handling every aspect of his health with skill and compassion, from routine visits to more complex surgeries. She is incredibly professional and truly cares about her patients. The team of vet techs is just as amazing, always showing kindness and attentiveness. I feel confident knowing he's in such capable hands!
Very professional and cozy for pets. Thank you all for working hard to make our pets feel happy.

Super nice people!!!
Thank you for the service
Amazing folks!
